description: List or change your own tools (only yours): ls, get one in full, add a tool folder, rm, reset. Changes work at once. Self tools not in your default set, add them when needed: self_llm, self_system, self_history, self_ctl, e.g. {"op": "add", "path_json": {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/lib/tools/agent/self_history"}}. More: aos/me/self_tools.md.

name.description: get, rm: the tool name; add: the name to use (default folder name)

path.description: add: tool folder, JSON file or executable

path_json.description: add: a directive instead of path, like {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/lib/tools/base/math"}

replace.description: add: true = replace a tool of the same name

envs.description: add: fixed env values for this tool

env_file.description: add: a KEY=VALUE file read on every call

no_cache.description: add: re-ask an executable for its definition
